name: cheap-execution
what: Cost rules for agent work: rung ladder (search, code, prune, do-here, cheaper executor), briefs with READ/WRITE/ACCEPTANCE, fan-out width, byte-identical prefixes, plan-file handoff to a fresh agent
done_test: Claim a saving only from the same task measured before and after, same conditions: no token type rose, one fell, done-check passes.
evidence: handoff to fresh thread: long thread re-read ~325k tokens/call, one turn read 1.29M and gave no reply (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv 'Fresh thread from a handoff file'); background scripts: 15,108-removal sweep 11 min at 0 tokens (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv); worker for one grep cost 43,909 tokens, few-file search 124,928 (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); cache reads 95-97% of input (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv, cheap-execution.zip claim 98.6%)
failures: numbers inside it are untested defaults; no before/after token measurement of the skill itself exists
scope: token and wall cost of dispatching, reading, repeating and handing off agent work
not_scope: correctness of the product; context-shaping mechanisms such as hooks or plugins (context-mechanism-ab); the lean-execution deltas

name: lean-execution
what: Variant of cheap-execution adding: smallest case first for gated or irreversible steps, rung 0 (skip what changes no next act), ritual-to-construction, and a dispatch ledger (ledger.sh hook: ACCEPTANCE required, open rows block Stop)
lives_at: account skill anthropic-skills:lean-execution; source TOOLS/lean-execution/SKILL.md + ledger.sh
done_test: Dispatch ledger: one row per dispatch naming its ACCEPTANCE; only your own run pays it; open rows = not done; empty ledger = unchecked, never a pass.
evidence: ledger.sh fixtures 5 of 5 planted faults caught, found 3 text-vs-script mismatches; skill 678 -> 677 words after adding the ledger (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv 'lean-execution'); dispatch-ledger hooks pass plants on simulated input (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv)
failures: dispatch ledger not proven live, install route undecided (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv 'Dispatch-ledger hooks' untested); description names one project
scope: irreversible or gated actions, recurring rituals turned into constructions, and paying each dispatch's acceptance
not_scope: the shared base rules on briefs, fan-out, cache and handoff (cheap-execution); searcher recall by hidden plants (blind-plant-calibration)

name: mesh-ledger
what: Write the goal as a formula whose terms are slots; list the target's atomic pieces; build a piece x slot matrix by removal runs; read stacks, misfits, needed, over- and under-definition rows; fix and rerun
done_test: Fix every row and rerun until every row left is proved impossible.
evidence: prompt-only auditors found 3-5 of 7 planted rows (LEDGER-METHOD/calib/SCORE.md); mesh.py run with hand, Haiku-blind and Sonnet-blind references found 7 of 7, clean tree exits 0, blind refs $0.32 (TOOLS/ledger-run/SCORE.md); mesh.py self-calibration 6 of 6 (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); joint search n+1 runs, worst 125 -> 25 (TOOLS/ledger-run/SCORE.md)
failures: a 'disagree' row says a term is missing or wrong, not which (calib/SCORE.md); prompt changes across 3 rounds did not converge; mapping code units to 17 seed lines left 2 terms with zero realizers (LEDGER-countdown-2026-09-23.md:40,89)
scope: whether an existing artifact's pieces exactly fill the terms its stated goal requires
not_scope: defects at seams between artifacts (seam-audit); minimality against a check suite (removal-test); fit declared before pieces exist (typed-holes)

name: typed-holes
what: Declare each slot as a typed hole (a Variable in a proof-assistant section) before pieces exist; a piece fits iff the checker accepts it there; a closure check fails if any declared hole is unconsumed
done_test: a piece fits iff coqc accepts it there (MESH-METHOD/PRIOR-ART.md); check.sh prints MESH CLOSED, and its plant prints MESH FAIL
evidence: sh VERIFY/MESH/check.sh reads MESH CLOSED (13 holes, 32 Variables; later 16/35), plant dropping one hole reads MESH FAIL (VERIFY/MESH/FINDINGS.md:3)
failures: judgment remains for prose and config pieces with no type; an under-stated type is the new underdefinition (inferred, MESH-METHOD/PRIOR-ART.md); no comparison against the untyped ledger was run
scope: declaring at design time what each slot must be so a type checker decides fit
not_scope: auditing pieces of an artifact that already exists (mesh-ledger); prose or config with no type

name: seam-audit
what: Agenda = one slot per (seam, fault class) read off the wiring; each check must be two-sided; matrix plant x check from runs; drop checks with nothing unique; pick the least-cost set of checks covering every seam (least-cost cover, research.py); one strong reader only for seams no check reaches
lives_at: COUNTDOWN-SEED/METHOD3/ (METHOD.md, RESULTS.tsv, seams.py, research.py, vac.sh, RESEARCH-AS-SEED.md)
done_test: An audit ends zero or impossible.
evidence: 11 hidden plants: checks alone 6 of 9 real at 0 tokens; checks plus one Opus reader 9 of 9 at 153k tokens; Haiku+Sonnet+Opus 7 of first 8 at 372k (COUNTDOWN-SEED/METHOD3/METHOD.md:40-43); Sonnet 0/8 at 124k, Haiku 0/8 at 95k (RESULTS.tsv); proof cell caught Admitted and weakened-statement plants (RESULTS.tsv H7,H8); least-cost cover met in 2 rounds at reader cost 70 and 400 (RESEARCH-AS-SEED.md)
failures: renumbering check and static duplicate pass: 3 tries, nothing unique, removed (METHOD.md:26); checks missed H5 (checker default) and H6 (write model); reader not repeatable
scope: hunting defects at every seam of a multi-file chain and choosing which checks to run
not_scope: fit of pieces to a goal (mesh-ledger); proving one check is valid (two-sided-check); attacking one proof version round by round (standing-adversary)

name: two-sided-check
what: Trust a check only after one run shows it green on the clean base and red on a plant of its own subject; a check red on the base is unwitnessed and is itself a finding; every claim is one row naming its check and the plant that reddens it
done_test: Watch each check fail on a fault in its subject, then pass, alone. (HIS-METHODS.md); green on the clean base and red on its seam's plant, in the same run (METHOD3/METHOD.md)
evidence: rule flagged a stale seed at 0 tokens where an Opus reader needed 153k (METHOD3/METHOD.md:14-16); target wiring 16 of 16 fault plants red, 3 form-only changes green (MESH/target/HANDOFF.md); gate 12 of 12 TERMS rows red under plants (PLANS/FIX-MZ.md:10); Makoto rule cases run on the installed hook: mesh distance 45 -> 0 (LEDGER/work/rows/memory.tsv)
failures: one-sided checks that passed while faulty: `command -v pytest` passed while the import failed; ResourceWarning guard logged but returned PASS for weeks; a Stop hook recorded 0 verdicts in 1,765 log lines (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); sweep seen-count 1 then 0 on the same commit (nondeterminism)
scope: establishing that one check can fail before its verdict is trusted
not_scope: which checks to keep (removal-test); recall of a searcher that is not a deterministic check (blind-plant-calibration)

name: removal-test
what: For each unit (line, name, check, row) remove it alone and rerun the suite and plants; keep it only if some plant turns green or the base turns red without it; re-check live references before deleting
done_test: Keep a check only where some planted fault reads green without it, or the seed reads red without it (memory countdown-seed-settled-2026-09-23.md)
evidence: checker 27 checks/647 lines -> 14 checks/522 lines, each catching a unique fault (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); 95-line seed -> 62 lines, all 49 names required (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); 129/129 placement rows red on removal, 93 helper rows green = duplicates (MESH/HANDOFF.md); pre-rm reference re-check kept 1 of 19 files still cited (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv)
failures: per-def pass on a 477-def tree: 277 checked, 0 removable, unfinished (PLANS/MAKOTO2.md:20-21); a plant on an input the spec rules out is vacuous and must be subtracted (PLANS/ATTACK2.md DECIDED)
scope: whether each named unit is required by an existing check suite and plant set
not_scope: sub-unit text spans and cost ranking among removals that keep checks green (removal-sweep-with-cost); fit to a goal formula (mesh-ledger)

name: removal-sweep-with-cost
what: Exhaustively remove every word span; classify each removal as red, green-same-path, or green-path-changing; apply same-path removals; for path-changing ones measure whole-run cost on both sides and keep the cheaper; repeat to a fixpoint; run as a background script
done_test: Where rounds, asks, work and CPU disagree, the seed keeps the side needing fewer of the [check runs] (COUNTDOWN-SEED/README.md); later sweeps converge to 0 same-path (fixpoint)
evidence: first sweep 115 green/38 same-path -> 4 applied, seed 62 -> 60 lines, evaluation work -6% (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); round 5: 15,108 spans, 23 green, 0 same-path (COUNTDOWN-SEED/README.md); edges removal +6,434 check runs, wave removal loses 57 met ends (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv); 77 path-changing removals -> 50 caught after closing checker holes (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
failures: span 3208 timed out at 600 s, NOT-EVALUABLE (README.md); 11 min per sweep; greedy minimizer only reaches a local minimum
scope: sub-unit text spans whose removal keeps every check green, decided by measured whole-run cost
not_scope: whole named units judged required or not (removal-test)

name: self-application
what: Run a method or tool on its own text or on its own meta-decisions (dogfood; research as an instance of the solver); every stop where it cannot say what to do next is a defect in the method
done_test: dogfood it and make the new steps, then attack, repeat until bulletproof (COUNTDOWN-SEED/HIS-METHODS.md)
evidence: research run as an instance: met in 2 rounds at reader cost 70 and 400, no change needed (RESEARCH-AS-SEED.md); seed on itself: 1 earned removal (17 -> 16) and 3 branch stops where it does not say what to do (DOGFOOD-seed-2026-09-23.md:7-9); ledger method on itself: 1 of 4 proposed rows accepted (LEDGER-METHOD/self/PROPOSED-METHOD-rows.tsv)
failures: self-audit rows were artifacts of the harness running only steps 1-4 (PROPOSED-METHOD-rows.tsv); dogfood stopped at 21 of 22 with three unresolved branch stops
scope: testing a method's universality by applying it to itself
not_scope: applying a method to an outside target (every other row)

name: prior-art-per-piece
what: One lookup per distinct mechanism (not per unit); a cheap model finds leads, a stronger model opens every citation by fetch before keeping it; a measured try on real inputs decides replace/add/none
lives_at: PRIOR-ART/ (README.md, pieces.tsv, ALTERNATIVES.tsv, OVERRIDES.tsv, tries/, math-tool/SCORE.md); memory prior-art-per-piece-2026-09-23.md
done_test: one row per piece in ALTERNATIVES.tsv; a missing raw/ID.md for a dispatched id is unfinished (PRIOR-ART/README.md)
evidence: 89 pieces: 30 measured superior, 17 replace, 8 add, 63 none (memory prior-art-per-piece); union-find 289.5x at n=500 same partitions; Signature.bind 1152/1152 vs hand-rolled 776/1152; temp+os.replace torn 0/12 vs 12/12 (PRIOR-ART/ALTERNATIVES.tsv:4,11,60); SCC wave 1.463 s -> 0.0055 s same output on 1,052,740 cases (OVERRIDES.tsv:2)
failures: Haiku citations and quotes often invented or spliced (memory); radix and pre-index candidates lost on real usage patterns (OVERRIDES.tsv:8-9, ALTERNATIVES.tsv:16-17); 5 rows open with no realizer to measure
scope: finding and measuring an existing better mechanism for each distinct piece
not_scope: choosing a whole method or tool family (blind-plant-calibration's bake-off); verifying the piece itself (two-sided-check)

name: blind-plant-calibration
what: Measure a searcher's recall (model auditor, reader, prover, tool) by hiding known faults in its input without telling it; drop a searcher that misses one; stop only when all plants are found and a different method's round adds nothing
done_test: The audit ends only when a DIFFERENT family's full round adds zero confirmed new findings. (METHOD2/METHOD.md)
evidence: prompt auditors 3-5 of 7 plants vs run-based 7 of 7 (LEDGER-METHOD/calib/SCORE.md); Sonnet and Haiku readers 0 of 8 at 124k/95k tokens (METHOD3/RESULTS.tsv); six provers 0 of 5 known divergences at 144k-226k tokens each, so Coq kept (PRIOR-ART/math-tool/SCORE.md); simulated false-stop 2-54% by family under Chao1 vs 5% with plants plus a second family (METHOD2/METHOD.md:38-44, simulated)
failures: in-family estimators (Chao1, Good-Turing) cannot see a shared blind spot and false-stop more for stronger searchers (METHOD2 sim)
scope: measuring recall of a searcher whose output is judgment rather than a deterministic verdict
not_scope: validating a deterministic check (two-sided-check); counting a population for coverage (census-before-coverage)

name: census-before-coverage
what: Before claiming coverage, enumerate the population by script (unique ids, paged to the end); coverage is a join of outputs against that census, never a worker's self-reported count
done_test: Coverage = script join with census; done when every id is covered. (PLANS/LEDGER.md DECIDED)
evidence: census 3,822 messages in 73 threads, full bodies set match True, 0 truncated (PLANS/LEDGER.md); worker self-counts matched the census in 24 of 58 threads, worst 2 vs 102 (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv 'Worker self-reported message counts'); proved-statement inventory 14,197 raw -> 3,979 distinct by layered subtraction (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv)
failures: name-regex 'dead code' census claimed 183 dead functions/1,945 lines, truth was 1 (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv); three stored thread roots end mid-sentence in the source itself
scope: establishing the full population before any coverage or completeness claim
not_scope: measuring a searcher's recall (blind-plant-calibration); duplicate shapes in code (shape-dedupe)

name: computed-verdict-ledger
what: Record each measurement as typed fields (thing, condition, metric, better, baseline, value, noise, done_test, correctness, fired, basis); the verdict is a function of those fields, never typed; a script lists rows on the same (thing, condition, metric) whose verdicts conflict
done_test: Verdict is computed, never typed. (SCHEMA2.md); verdict.py --conflicts exits 1 if any conflict
evidence: plant.tsv run: CONFLICT A | c | m: line 2 helped vs line 3 hurt, conflicts 1, rc=1; fired=no row computed void (run 2026-09-24 on LEDGER/work/plant.tsv); live context-mechanism rows re-read as void, not didnt-work, once fired=no was recorded (35/35 and 32/32 replacements discarded, PLANS/LEDGER.md DECIDED)
failures: untyped 8-column rows (LEDGER/work/rows/*.tsv) cannot be run through it; noise is '-' on most rows, so they compute unresolved-noise
scope: recording experiment outcomes so verdicts are derived and conflicts detected
not_scope: deciding what to measure; validating a check (two-sided-check); claims registry of a product (two-sided-check)

name: context-mechanism-ab
what: Before keeping any mechanism that shapes a model's context (elision, injection, dedupe, compaction), price it as Net = shrink - added text - extra calls, confirm it fired, and run a live A/B against off on the same task; offline replay is only an upper bound
done_test: The goal: Net(m) > 0 for every mechanism kept, success not lower than off. (DETIO-CAUSALITY/FORMULA.md)
evidence: replay 86% fewer tool-result chars but live same job 2.7x input, 1.95x cost, 41-45 turns vs 12-13 (TOOLS/RESULTS.tsv:3,27-29); thread-shaped job every DetIO run above every base run, 1.25x-3.5x (RESULTS.tsv:79); 140-turn session tool-output bytes -92% (RESULTS.tsv:85); fixed floor 48.5k tokens untouched by hooks, 22.5k with --tools flag (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); output capture cannot reach 90%: tool outputs only 23% of input cost (PLANS/TOOLS2.md FAILED)
failures: five delivery arms (connect.py, prompt injection, dedupe) all failed the cheaper rule (DETIO-CAUSALITY/from-detio-4.md, -5.md); live replacements discarded by the host, fired=no (PLANS/LEDGER.md)
scope: deciding whether a context-shaping mechanism is kept
not_scope: dispatch and read discipline of the agent itself (cheap-execution)

name: subtract-first
what: On any ordering conflict remove before adding; add only what a claim needs to become true; pay for each addition by a removal so a size bound stays flat
done_test: Subtract first. On any ordering conflict, removal before addition. Add only what a claim needs in order to become true. (CLAUDE.md)
evidence: three checks landed with bound 6422 -> 6422 by removing a second table source, a single-use helper and a defensive read (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); subtracting 770 owners kept with no reason -> 0, while folding the default instead cost +5,902 rounds (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); lean-execution 678 -> 677 words after additions (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
failures: subtracting a suffix-based freeze left 58 files unreached and editable, flagged as a design call (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
scope: ordering of removals and additions within one change
not_scope: deciding whether a unit is removable (removal-test, removal-sweep-with-cost)

name: shape-dedupe
what: Find duplication by shape, not name: byte-identical files, function bodies equal after blanking constants and alpha-renaming, and units no entry point reaches by a real call graph; collapse each group to one parameterised unit
done_test: No file committed twice. No body written twice. No unreachable unit. (COUNTDOWN-METHOD.md)
evidence: 39% waste, 76,278 of 195,854 lines; Loop.v triplication -70,966 lines with EXTRACTION 12 of 12 PASS (LEDGER/work/rows/memory.tsv); readers dedup bound 6422 -> 6351, zero on all three measures (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); 5 duplicate proof sets -> 1 (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); shape check found 29 groups (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
failures: name-regex reachability missed dotted access: removals broke self-test, 183 claimed dead vs 1 real (LEDGER/work/rows/threads.tsv); 18 apparently dead functions were dynamic-dispatch entries (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
scope: duplicate or unreachable code found by normalized shape
not_scope: a unit required by checks but unique (removal-test); population counts (census-before-coverage)

name: keyed-check-replay
what: Key each check unit by a hash of the inputs it reads; replay the recorded result when the key is unchanged; plant a fault that neuters the key comparison to prove the skip is sound
lives_at: FULL-READ-2026-09-23.md:286,298; LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv 'gate full recording', 'keyed two-phase compile'
done_test: the only thing tested is the change with the recorded I/O (COUNTDOWN-SEED/HIS-METHODS.md); plant record_gate (neuters the skip comparison) reads red
evidence: gate warm pass 769 s -> 4 s, recording costs 372 s once (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); proof compile 174.9 s -> 73.8 s cold, 8.7 s warm, 2.7 s for one touched unit of 54 (FULL-READ-2026-09-23.md:286); read ledger 271 -> 95 opens, verdict lines byte-identical (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
failures: file-level keys fan out: one changed file cost 1,196 s; function-level keys need a reach trace (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
scope: making a repeated deterministic check suite cheap to rerun
not_scope: agent token cost (cheap-execution); deciding which checks exist (removal-test)

name: differential-reference
what: Run two executables of one spec (proof-extracted kernel vs literal evaluator, two readings of an ambiguous clause, program vs reference) on the same exhaustive corpus and diff every output; each disagreement is a finding with its instance as witness
done_test: Every disagreement is a finding with its instance as the witness. (METHOD2/METHOD.md); rerun kdiff to 0 (VERIFY/MESH/PROCESS.md)
evidence: kernel vs evaluator: 7,339 translated, 102 disagreements in 3 classes with witnesses (PLANS/ATTACK2.md); extraction vs evaluator SAME n=7431, planted changes read DIFF (FIXES/Measure-Zero-Dev/seed-harness/README.md:11-13); two readings met False vs True on one instance (PLANS/NAIVE.md:13); reading plus same-path comparison found 5 divergences no prover found (PRIOR-ART/math-tool/SCORE.md); bounded-exhaustive 7,510 instances: checker wrong on 100 (VERIFY/HOLDOUT.md)
failures: a stale reference left 2,840 disagreements unadjudicated (VERIFY/HOLDOUT.md); a disagreement says which instance, not which side is wrong
scope: comparing two executable readings of one spec over the same corpus
not_scope: fit of pieces to goal terms (mesh-ledger); a single check's validity (two-sided-check)

name: standing-adversary
what: Keep one adversary whose only job is to attack each new version of a proof or spec, each round ending in runnable witness scripts or 'no counterexample', with the finding's cost measured on the real instance
done_test: Does this actually follow the definition above, attack until they do (COUNTDOWN-SEED/HIS-METHODS.md); each round ends in a witness or 'No counterexample' (DISPROVE/FINDINGS.md)
evidence: 11 rounds found real defects proof review missed: shared-site double counting (J 10 lines vs Ja+Jb 12), route shut off after round one, one local failure switching every part (DISPROVE/FINDINGS.md rounds 7-11)
failures: several findings are real but cost 0 on the current instance (7 of 943 sites, none affected); some fixes stay inferred, not proved
scope: attacking successive versions of one proof or spec for counterexamples
not_scope: reproducing findings someone else made (claim-replay); covering every seam with checks (seam-audit)

name: claim-replay
what: Before acting on an outside critique, replay every claim against the current files and classify it refuted, real, or narrower; fix only the real ones at their root
done_test: none stated; derived: every claim carries refuted/real/narrower with the command that decided it (PLANS/ATTACK2.md)
evidence: 23 claims: 14 refuted, 9 real, 5 narrower (PLANS/ATTACK2.md:9); '11 of 62 roots' refuted by grep of each root (PLANS/ATTACK2.md); replay caught a stale round-1 audit copy (LEDGER/work/rows/seed.tsv); v10 audit 42 findings -> 2 reproduced, 11 already fixed (LEDGER/work/rows/seed.tsv)
failures: none measured
scope: reproducing third-party findings before acting on them
not_scope: producing new findings (standing-adversary, seam-audit)

name: failure-register-to-checks
what: Map every entry of a failure register to a check; merge entries that need the same evidence into one family and one check; write each check as a tell of at most ten words; mark entries no check can decide
done_test: A family is what a checker must have in hand to catch its entries; two families needing the same thing are one. (HIS-METHODS.md)
evidence: 74 entries: 69 prevented by construction, 5 need own row, 4 of those replaceable, 1 undecidable (minimality) (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); 11 entries fall to one shared fresh-clone check; checks over 10 words 18 -> 0 (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv)
failures: none measured
scope: turning a list of known failure kinds into the fewest checks
not_scope: checks for a goal's terms (mesh-ledger); validating each resulting check (two-sided-check)

name: priced-dag
what: Clarify the goal (self-contradiction, subjects and operators, sources, narrowers with a two-way deletion test, valid-answer tests), break it into a DAG of narrower-edits each with declared cost (lines, runs, new shapes), build math first; a node over its declared cost goes red
done_test: A node whose actual cost exceeds its declared cost goes red, exactly as a failing test does. (COUNTDOWN-METHOD.md)
evidence: declared-vs-measured cost matched across rounds in countdown_plants.py (FULL-READ-2026-09-23.md:1392-1415) measures only the tracker; no end-to-end run of the method
failures: ten-step method match: only the back half (~5 of 10) found implemented in 4 repos (LEDGER/work/rows/th0*.tsv); 4 open questions pending the owner (COUNTDOWN-METHOD.md)
scope: planning a change from goal to build with cost declared per node
not_scope: auditing an artifact that exists (mesh-ledger, seam-audit)

name: anti-list
what: Planned list of methods measured not to work, each with the measurement, so no successor retries them (Chao1/Good-Turing stops, blind provers, static hook gates, output-only context capture, name-regex dead code)
done_test: none (not built)
evidence: sources for its rows: METHOD2 sim false-stop 2-54%; six provers 0 of 5 (PRIOR-ART/math-tool/SCORE.md); hook gates 0 of 5 faults (TOOLS/RESULTS.tsv:4,47-51,65-70); vacuous-test detector 0 of 20 (RESULTS.tsv:34-38)
failures: not built
scope: recording methods measured to fail so they are not retried
